name: dsh-plugin-afp
description: AFP photo curation for DSH Agents: resumable visual dry-runs and approved private-collection writes

prompt.en: Check AFP setup and private collection counts with afp_status and afp_collections. Do not modify AFP.
prompt.zh: 请用 afp_status 和 afp_collections 检查 AFP 配置和私有收藏夹数量，不修改远端。

prompt.en: Run an AFP food visual dry-run, collect the job result, and show the report. Do not write AFP.
prompt.zh: 请对 AFP 食物分类执行视觉筛选 dry-run，收集后台任务结果并展示报告，不写入 AFP。

description.en: Search photos, browse collection metadata and inspect account setup.
description.zh: 实际搜索图片、浏览收藏夹元数据并检查账号配置。

details.en:
Check account setup, plan queries offline, search actual photos with paging, and read photo details, collection lists and members.

Actual reads require AFP credentials or a token. Search uses caption text and the selected language; it does not translate input or execute offline plan filters. This feature does not purchase images or change collections.
details.zh:
检查账号配置、离线规划关键词、实际搜索并翻页，读取图片详情、收藏夹列表和成员。

实际读取需要 AFP 凭据或令牌。搜索使用说明文字和所选语言，不自动翻译或执行离线计划中的筛选条件。本功能不购买图片或修改收藏夹。

description.en: Screen photos and save results, with support for resuming interrupted runs.
description.zh: 筛选图片并保存结果，支持中断后继续。

details.en:
Find candidates for selected categories, screen them with a vision model, and generate a report. Interrupted runs can resume from saved progress.

Requires AFP credentials and a vision model with an API key. Results stay local and are not automatically written to collections.
details.zh:
按选定分类检索候选图片，通过视觉模型筛选并生成报告。任务中断后可从已保存的进度继续。

需配置 AFP 账号、视觉模型及密钥；筛选结果仅保存在本地，不会自动写入收藏夹。

description.en: Append, replace, or clear collections after confirming a preview.
description.zh: 确认预览后，追加、替换或清空收藏夹。

details.en:
Append screening results, replace existing contents, or clear a selected collection. Each operation shows the target and proposed changes and asks for confirmation.

A failed write may leave partial changes. Review the result before creating another operation; writes are not automatically retried or undone.
details.zh:
将筛选结果追加到收藏夹、替换现有内容，或清空指定收藏夹。操作前会展示目标收藏夹和具体变更，请求确认。

写入失败时可能已有部分内容变更；请核对结果后重新创建操作，不会自动重试或撤销。

description.en: Open the AFP workbench from Settings.
description.zh: 从设置页面进入 AFP 操作台。

details.en:
Adds an AFP entry to Settings for task progress, screening reports, and collection operations.

All entries share one workbench. Hiding this entry does not stop running tasks.
details.zh:
在设置侧栏增加 AFP 入口，可查看任务进度、筛选报告和收藏夹操作。

各入口共用同一操作台；关闭此入口不会停止正在执行的任务。

description.en: Open the AFP workbench from the home sidebar.
description.zh: 从首页侧栏进入 AFP 操作台。

details.en:
Adds an AFP entry to the home sidebar for tasks, reports, and collection operations.

Tasks continue when you navigate away. Hiding the active entry returns you to an available page.
details.zh:
在首页侧栏增加 AFP 入口，便于集中查看任务、报告与收藏夹操作。

切换到其他页面时任务继续执行；关闭当前入口后会返回可用页面。

description.en: View AFP tasks and reports within conversations.
description.zh: 在会话页面查看 AFP 任务与报告。

details.en:
Adds an AFP tab to conversations so you can view the shared workbench without leaving the conversation.

The tab does not create a separate task queue. Agent jobs remain managed by their original conversation.
details.zh:
在会话页增加 AFP 标签，无需离开会话即可查看共享操作台。

此标签不会创建独立任务队列；由 Agent 发起的任务仍归原会话管理。

description.en: Plan photo searches by news topic and time range.
description.zh: 按新闻主题与时间范围规划图片检索。

details.en:
Plan searches around news topics and time ranges, helping the Agent find relevant photos and inspect collections.

Searching and screening require the corresponding tools to be enabled. Collection changes ask for confirmation.
details.zh:
围绕新闻主题和时间范围规划检索，帮助 Agent 找到相关图片并核对收藏夹。

实际检索与筛选需开启对应工具；修改收藏夹前会请求确认。

description.en: Plan search filters and check target collections.
description.zh: 规划检索条件，核对目标收藏夹。

details.en:
Help the Agent plan search filters, inspect private collections, and check the intended write target.

Reading collections requires AFP credentials. Append, replace, and clear operations show a preview and ask for confirmation.
details.zh:
帮助 Agent 规划检索条件、检查私有收藏夹，并核对准备写入的目标。

读取收藏夹需配置 AFP 账号；追加、替换或清空内容前会展示预览并请求确认。

description.en: Decide which photos to keep by inspecting their visible content.
description.zh: 根据实际画面判断图片是否保留。

details.en:
Guide the Agent in scoring, categorizing, and deduplicating photos from their visible content, with reasons for keeping or rejecting each image.

Requires visual screening tools and a configured model. Titles and captions alone do not establish acceptance.
details.zh:
指导 Agent 根据实际画面进行评分、分类和去重，说明每张图片保留或淘汰的理由。

需开启视觉筛选工具并配置模型；仅凭标题或说明文字不会判定图片合格。

description.en: Select animal photos with clear subjects and natural composition.
description.zh: 筛选主体清晰、构图自然的动物图片。

details.en:
Screen mammal and bird photos for subject completeness, clarity, surroundings, and composition. Reject graphic scenes, distressed animals, and obstructed subjects.

Requires visual screening tools. Review the screening report before confirming collection changes.
details.zh:
围绕哺乳动物与鸟类筛选图片，检查主体完整度、清晰度、环境与构图，并排除血腥、受困或主体被遮挡的画面。

需开启视觉筛选工具；先生成筛选报告，再确认是否加入收藏夹。

description.en: Screen landscape photos for quality and duplicate content.
description.zh: 筛选风景图片，检查质量与重复内容。

details.en:
Help the Agent plan landscape searches, inspect image quality and composition, remove duplicates, and organize candidates.

Requires visual screening tools. Screening produces a report; collection changes ask for confirmation.
details.zh:
帮助 Agent 规划风景图片检索，检查画面质量、构图与重复内容，整理候选图片。

需开启视觉筛选工具；筛选后生成报告，加入收藏夹前会请求确认。

description.en: Select celestial and cosmic images suitable for wallpapers.
description.zh: 筛选适合作为壁纸的天体与宇宙图片。

details.en:
Screen planets, nebulae, galaxies, and other cosmic images for subject coverage, visual density, and wallpaper composition. Reject excessive empty black backgrounds and terrestrial night scenes.

Requires visual screening tools and a configured model. Review the report before confirming collection operations.
details.zh:
筛选行星、星云、星系等宇宙题材图片，检查主体占比、画面密度和壁纸构图，排除大面积空黑背景或地面夜景。

需开启视觉筛选工具并配置模型；先查看筛选报告，再确认收藏夹操作。

scripts.prepack: npm run build:client && npm run check
